messages:
release-bot: :rotating_light: Deploy request queued for hotfix 'tokenizer-eu-bias' to prod-eu. pipeline: https://ci.internal/redwood/pipelines/7321
release-bot: Summary: models/tokenizer v3.4.1 -> v3.4.2, fixes tokenization edge on long prefixes; risk: minor latency regression possible
maria_s: seeing elevated parse error rate in eu1 since 10:12 UTC, suspect tokenizer. Can we fast-track this?
jonah: confirmed, small spike ~0.6% parse errors on embed path. Impacting a handful of customers.
ops_oncall: change window open now until 15:00 UTC. Ok for expedited hotfix if we keep canary short.
kevin_l: request: pin rollout to 5% canary in eu first, 10m checks, then 50% then full if healthy. Rollback if errors >0.5% or p95 latency +30ms
sophia_p: +1 on the criteria. Also please annotate release notes: "fix long-prefix token split" and include regression test id RT-4482
maria_s: Can engineering lead approve expedited deploy? This would normally wait for next window.
amy_r: i'm good to approve from product side; customers impacted. :thumbsup:
jonah: eng approval: go ahead from infra side but require deploy annotations and pin command in message for audit
maria_s: adding pin command in case we need it: `redwoodctl rollout pin models/tokenizer@v3.4.1 --reason "hotfix rollback"`
kevin_l: quick checklist: 1) canary 5% eu, 2) perf traces on, 3) long-tail alarms enabled, 4) disable auto-scale burst for this rollout
sophia_p: I'll monitor canary metrics and check evals. Keeping manual hold between phases.
release-bot: Per policy, expedited approvals required: 2x engineering leads and ops_oncall. Waiting for second eng approval.
amy_r: product already approved (as noted).
jonah: i'm the second eng lead, approving now. :shipit:
sophia_p: ack. starting canary release 5% eu now.
deploy-bot: Starting rollout: models/tokenizer -> v3.4.2, target: eu1-canary-5, initiated by sophia_p at 1850012460
deploy-bot: Canary phase started. Link: https://deploys.internal/redwood/rollouts/7321
sophia_p: canary metrics at +2m: parse errors back to baseline, latency +5ms p95. No regressions in eval harness. :eyes:
ops_oncall: watching logs; no error spikes. If anything goes >0.5% notify and pin rollback.
kevin_l: after 10m canary check, ramp to 50% if stable.
release-bot: Note: autoscaler policy temporarily set to fixed for this rollout per kevin_l
sophia_p: 10m check passed. ramping to 50% now.
deploy-bot: Rollout update: 50% eu in progress at 1850012760
sophia_p: 50% steady for 5m. p95 +7ms, errors 0.12%. proceeding to full roll after 5m hold.
amy_r: thumbs up from product. communicate to affected customers in #customer-status
jonah: final hold released. proceeding to full.
deploy-bot: Rollout completed to 100% eu at 1850012905. No automated rollbacks triggered.
sophia_p: post-deploy checks green. merging release notes and tagging with RT-4482.
maria_s: thanks team. leaving the rollback pin command in ticket in case we need it later.
ops_oncall: closing loop — monitoring for 2 hours per policy. Will escalate if anything turns up. :white_check_mark:
